# 📜 Audit Logs, Worklogs & Commit Ledger (`logs/`)

Automated repository worklogs, structured commit ledgers, verification audit reports, and pre-commit compliance records.

## Files & Structure

* **[`commits.jsonl`](./commits.jsonl)**: Immutable, structured JSONL ground-truth ledger automatically generated by the Git post-commit hook (`scripts/log-commit.ts`). Includes commit hash, conventional commit metadata, diff metrics, author, timestamp, and affected micro-apps.
* **[`WORKLOGS.md`](./WORKLOGS.md)**: Automated chronological worklog summary with short commit hashes and diff statistics (`YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm | [<shortHash>] <subject> (+<ins>, -<del>)`).
* **[`reports/`](./reports/)**: Categorized monthly atomic commit audit reports (`YYYY-MM/REPORT_<date>_<shortHash>.md`) and [`LATEST_COMMIT_REPORT.md`](./reports/LATEST_COMMIT_REPORT.md) generated strictly per Git commit by the post-commit ledger (`scripts/log-commit.ts`). Includes full commit metadata, changes overview, diff statistics, file change tables, and verification gate compliance.


## Commit Record JSON Schema
```json
{
  "hash": "618acdb98f24...",
  "shortHash": "618acdb",
  "timestamp": "2026-08-21T18:11:19.000Z",
  "dateStr": "2026-08-21 23:41",
  "author": "dev-engineer",
  "type": "feat",
  "scope": "proxy",
  "message": "parameterize reverse proxy via .env",
  "stats": {
    "filesChanged": 3,
    "insertions": 42,
    "deletions": 12
  },
  "affectedApps": ["edge-proxy", "landing"]
}
```
